verdict.rationale: Running local inference across CPU architectures is a fair question for a local LLM runtime like LM Studio. The evidence pack never mentions PowerPC or any architecture beyond x86 and ARM. The llama.cpp and Apple MLX backend mentions say nothing about other CPU architectures, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC
